name: hepi-mono
description: Monorepo for HEPI Pi Coding Agent extensions.

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@hheei/pi-ext-core && npm run build --workspace=@hheei/pi-auto-title && npm run build --workspace=@hheei/pi-btw && npm run build --workspace=@hheei/pi-dollar-skill && npm run build --workspace=@hheei/pi-ext-addon && npm run build --workspace=@hheei/pi-ext-tools && npm run build --workspace=@hheei/pi-settings && npm run build --workspace=@hheei/pi-status && npm run build --workspace=@hheei/pi-t2s
scripts.check: biome check . && npm run typecheck && npm test
